text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, a Classic race and the first
race of
the Tiara tour, is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting forever for this race!
Come on,
Mejiro Dober! Make this your
first tiara!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
I bet she's going to be absolutely
amazing today!
I can't wait to see her in
action!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The crowd is so loud... So this is what the
Classic
G1 Oka Sho is like...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're right. This isn't my first G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The racer I am today... can handle this
race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was going to even without you nagging
me
about it.
